title: Recursion that runs out of stack
description:
Every function call uses a little stack. `sumOfSquares` below calls itself once per number, so asking for a million numbers needs a million stack frames, and the program dies with a stack overflow.

The recursion is not needed. Rewrite the function with a loop: a loop uses the same few bytes of stack however long it runs. The tests call it with `n` up to 1,000,000.
unitTests:
TEST("small values") { CHECK_EQ(sumOfSquares(0), 0); CHECK_EQ(sumOfSquares(3), 14); CHECK_EQ(sumOfSquares(10), 385); }
TEST("a million, without overflowing the stack") { CHECK_EQ(sumOfSquares(1000000), 333333833333500000LL); }

grading.unitTests:
